items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: But shortly after that, about a year and a half, he went with Andy Kust.

ctx.x: town tomorrow, and he said, if you come and go to my home and tell your mother what you're telling me, she'll buy me one. It cost $70. So I went to his home, I say, I told her, this boy here, you'll never be ashamed of him, you'll be proud, if you go buy this guitar. So she gave him $70 and he went right down with me, he bought a guitar and he got the steel guitar, because he could play a little. But he didn't own one.

But shortly after that, about a year and a half, he went with Andy Kust. And he made that, and he come up. I say, well, I can't show any other guys anything else. (Unintelligible) ready to teach me (unintelligible). I was proud of the guys there, you know, they moved so fast, both of them. Floyd moved fast, too. Because that was a good commercial blues he made. That's what it was.
